description.value: Kwong Tung Seafood Restaurant is a traditional Chinese seafood and dim sum restaurant located on the second floor of a building on Fisgard Street in Victoria's Chinatown district. The menu features live seafood, Shanghai dumplings, sticky rice, BBQ pork buns, and specialty hot pots, with a notable range of vegetarian and vegan options. It is a well-established local favourite praised for generous portions and fast, friendly service.
